dt-example.title: Column visibility buttons
dt-example.info:
The `-button colvis` provides an easy way for an end user to select which columns they want to see in the DataTable. This example demonstrates StateRestore's ability to save and restore column visibility.
The `columnVisibility` option of `-init stateRestore.include` option is set to `null` in this example, so you can selectively include, or exclude, the column visibility status in the state.
